description: Each character area shader's generic data, which only the library loads and resolves (CjsCharacterLibraryManager); the paper doll sets the result, in the shape of Carbon's EveSOFDataGenericShader. Ours: the client's paper doll is Python, so no Carbon source states these. shader: the shader file name, lowercase. parameters: kept for Carbon's shape and left empty (Carbon filters hull parameters by it; the paper doll has none). Every shader a character area uses has an entry (the library refuses a model with a shader that has none, where Carbon stops building that batch type); the eye, hair and portrait shaders need nothing. defaultTextures: a texture fills the slot of that name where the area leaves it empty or has none; an authored binding is kept. List only textures the shader samples: the compiled glass and portrait shaders sample neither lookup map. Every character model (483, build 3698585) leaves FresnelLookupMap empty and authors ColorNdotLLookupMap as the NdotL library or leaves it empty; an empty NdotL slot gives no diffuse from any light, only ambient. defaultParameters: values every area of the shader starts from (none yet). rules: parameters set on the areas a rule picks by part category, batch (TriBatchType name) and atlas region; an empty list picks any. DecalClip 1 makes the shader discard a pixel whose diffuse alpha is below 192/255 (the effect's annotation: Decal clipping = 1.0, Opaque clipping = 0.0); the areas below author none, and the compiled 0 drew their cut-away texels black: a hair style's BRDF areas in the hair or body region (the braided buns' band and rear clip), and the decal and transparent DoubleLinear areas of the body carriers' categories (the torso's shells; none of the 25 garment models in those categories has such an area in build 3698585, and one that did would clip too). A hair style ships no accessory-region maps, so its accessory-region areas (hair_bun_hp_02 glass helmet, the only one) sample the hair maps whole at their own UVs: TransformUV0 the identity, over the area placement. A value is four floats; a float parameter reads the first. In the generic's own shape: `areaShaders`, a CjsCharacterDataShader each, keyed by `shader`; a library's generic shader replaces the shipped one of its name. Edit freely: the library reads this file as data.
